concept.banner: The dashboard's run view. The name sits in the sidebar where the app has it. A run of an invented pipeline is paused at its human approval gate: four nodes are green, the conditional edges (risk == "high" / "low") show that the route is code, the gate is the current node, the last node is pending; the table lists what each node wrote to state.
concept.diagram: The architecture drawn as a pipeline in the same graph component: Browser and CLI, dashboard, engine (the current node), prompt DSL, runtimes and their adapters, database, approval gate; three cards explain the engine, a node and a gate.

data: The pipeline (support-triage), its nodes, durations and token counts are invented. No names, hosts or tokens.
